FAQs - Pequod's Pizza
FAQs - Pequod's Pizza About Us FAQs Merch Chicago Menu Reservations Order Online Morton Grove Menu Reservations Order Online Suburban Delivery Private Events Select Page Frequently Asked Questions What style of pizza is Pequod’s? Pequod’s Pizza is pan-style, a close variant on Chicago deep-dish style pizza. Which Pequod’s is the original? Our Morton Grove location is our original location, opening back in 1970. Do you have parking available? Street parking is generally available for both our Chicago and Morton Grove locations. Do I need a reservation? We always recommend making a reservation through our partner Tock, as walk-in availability is limited. On short notice, you can call the restaurant for current availability. What are your hours? The Chicago location is open Monday – Saturday: 11am – 2am and Sunday: 11am – 12am. In Morton Grove, the hours are as follows: Monday – Thursday: 11am – 9:30pm, Friday: 11am – 11:30pm, Saturday: 12pm – 11:30pm, Sunday: 12pm – 9:30pm. Are you wheelchair accessible? Yes, both Pequod’s locations are wheelchair accessible. Please let us know about any mobility constraints that would prevent your party from using stairs. Do you have outdoor seating? The Morton Grove location has outdoor seating available as weather permits. Do you offer Take-out or Delivery? We do offer both Take-out and Delivery options. *Take-out and delivery pizza orders will be uncut to ensure the highest quality pizza. If you would like your pizza cut, please specify when ordering. Do you ship your pizzas? We ship our pizzas nationwide throughout the U.S. and Canada with Goldbelly . How do you pronounce Pequod's? Pee-kwaadz . When is it busiest during the week/day? Our busiest day is Saturday, and our peak hours are typically the dinner rush between 6-8PM. How far in advance should you reserve a table? Weekday Lunches: Same Day Weekday Dinners: 1-2 days in advance Weekend Lunches (Fri-Sun): 2 days in advance Weekend Dinners (Fri-Sun): Groups Under 5: 1 week in advance Groups of 5-6: 2 weeks in advance Groups of 7 or more: 3 weeks in advance *These are general guidelines based on typical business. During holidays or major Chicago events (like the Chicago Marathon), these lead times are longer. Where do I pick up my Take-out order? You will receive a check number via email or text message when your order is ready. Once you receive that message you can pick up your order the the respective restaurant. In Morton Grove, Take-out orders can be picked up at our valet window in the alley next to the restaurant. In Chicago, Take-out orders are available for pick up at the host stand. On Friday & Saturday from 4pm – 9pm and Sunday from 5pm – 8pm, all Take-out orders are available at Whale Tale just two doors down from Pequod’s. Can I pre-order? You can place orders for Take-out and Delivery in advance by calling the restaurant or ordering online at order.pequodspizza.com. Due to health department regulations, standard dine-in orders cannot be placed in advance. Do you have gluten-free crust options? We do not currently offer any gluten-free crust options for our pizzas. Do you offer vegan cheese? We do not currently offer cheese alternatives as an option for our pizzas. What is the order cut-off time? The last order must be placed at least 30 minutes prior to the restaurant’s closing time. How many people does your pizza feed? For pan pizzas, we suggest: Personal (7”): 1 person Small (10”): 1-2 people Medium (12”): 2-3 people Large (14”): 4-5 people For thin crust, we recommend: Small (10”): 1-2 people Medium (12”): 2-3 people Large (16”): 4-5 people. How many toppings can I put on my pizza? You can add as few or as many toppings as you would like to your pizza. We recommend no more than 5 toppings. If you choose to add toppings that are known for losing water during the cooking process (onion, green pepper, mushroom, tomato), we recommend adding extra cheese to reduce fogginess. Do you host Private Events? Yes! Our team enjoys hosting private events ranging from birthdays, rehearsal dinners, anniversaries, staff parties, baby showers and more. Send us an email at reserve@pequodspizza.com for more information! Do you offer Catering? We do offer catering options tailored to your needs. To inquire, please email service@pequodspizza.com . What can I do while I'm waiting for a table to open up? Guests can grab a drink and wait at Whale Tale, or visit a nearby local bar. What's the Chicago location neighborhood like? The immediate area is fairly residential and generally safe. There isn’t much in the way of sightseeing within close walking distance. (It’s worth the trip, though: trust us.) Do you have to order using a QR code? We are not currently using QR codes for dine-in. It is being used for To-Go orders. When QR ordering is available, it’s always optional, not required. All of our meats are gluten free except our Burnt Ends. Some of our sides are gluten free, please call the store to find out which ones. Our Sweet Baby Jane Sauce and Carolina Vinegar are gluten free. Have additional allergen questions? Give us a call at 314.535.4340. Do You Ship Sauces, Rubs and Swag? Yes! You can order our famous rubs, sauces, t-shirts and hats for nationwide deliver. Shop now Can I Bring a Big Group To Pappy's? We always want to know when big groups are coming in so we can plan accordingly. We can accommodate almost any size group; and we ask that the entire party is present before joining the line as this is the only way to seat your group together. TIP: If your group is between 20-64, you may want to reserve our private banquet room. Learn more Do You Deliver? We do not deliver; however, you can order Pappy's for delivery through Uber Eats. Learn More How Do I Place An Order for Pick Up? All pick up orders can be placed by calling Pappy's directly at (314) 535-4340 . You can also place an order online. order online st. louis order online st. peters TIP: Please call 24-48 hours in advance of your pick up day and time. Can I Order Pappy's to be Shipped Out of Town? Yes, all of our sides are vegetarian except our Baked Beans. See below. Vegetarian Sides: Slaw, Potato Salad, Fried Corn on the Cob, Sweet Potato Fries, Green Beans, and Applesauce. Non-Vegetarian Sides: Baked Beans Do You Cater? Yes. From corporate meetings and events to private parties to wedding receptions and rehearsal dinners, Pappy's has got you covered! Frequently Asked Questions - Zachary's Chicago Pizza
Frequently Asked Questions - Zachary's Chicago Pizza Facebook Instagram About Us Our Pizza Our People Our Story Pizza Art Awards and Press Fundraising at Zachary’s Business Accounts Locations & Menus Oakland - Rockridge Oakland - Grand Lake North Berkeley Pleasant Hill Pleasanton Livermore Order Online Pickup DoorDash Grubhub UberEats Jobs Blog Gifts & Swag Newsletter Select Page Search Frequently Asked Questions Do you deliver? Delivery is available via our third-party delivery partners DoorDash and Uber Eats. Availability varies by location. We want to inform our customers that restaurant delivery services almost always add high surcharges to menu items as well as delivery fees. We also offer take-out, online ordering for pickup, and dine in. Can I order a partially cooked pizza to finish at home? Ordering a pizza half-baked is a great option if you don’t want to eat our pizza right away. We will partially cook your pizza and you can finish cooking it at your convenience. We stock a few “grab-n-go” half-baked options at all five locations. These sell on a first come, first served basis. If you have a special half-baked pizza in mind, please call ahead to place your order. Side note: Zachary’s half-baked pizzas travel well! Customers regularly drive and fly pizzas all across the country- and even overseas! Bring some Bay Area pizza love to your far-away friends and family. How do I cook a half-baked pizza? Make sure the pizza is at room temperature. Do not take the pizza directly from refrigeration and try to cook it! Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Take the pizza out of the box and slide it from the cardboard circle onto a buttered cookie sheet. Place the pizza on the middle rack of the oven and bake it until it becomes golden brown. Thin pizzas will cook in 10-15 minutes. Stuffed pizzas will cook in 15-20 minutes. **We do not recommend freezing our pizzas! Do you take reservations? Yes, we do! At Zachary’s Rockridge, Grand Lake, North Berkeley, Pleasanton, and Livermore, reservations are accepted 7 days a week! Zachary’s Pleasant Hill accepts reservations all day Sunday-Thursday and until 4:30pm Fridays. Friday night and Saturdays remain walk-in only at our Pleasant Hill restaurant. If you’re making a reservation for 6 or fewer you can do so via the links below. For reservations of more than 6, please call us directly. Zachary’s Oakland- ROCKRIDGE Zachary’s Oakland- GRAND LAKE Zachary’s NORTH BERKELEY Zachary’s PLEASANT HILL Zachary’s PLEASANTON Zachary’s LIVERMORE Can I place an order over the phone and then come to dine in the restaurant? We take dine-in orders over the phone 11 am- 4 pm only. We encourage you to order in advance, but the seating is first come, first served. After 4 pm we are only able to accept take-out orders over the phone. If there is a wait for tables when you arrive, you will be able to order your pizza after you receive an estimated wait time. What is the difference between Zachary’s STUFFED & THIN pizza? Not to be confused with “Sicilian” style, “Stuffed Crust” or other “deep dish” pizzas, Zachary’s Stuffed Chicago Style pizza is something else altogether. A thin layer of our house made pizza dough is tucked into a deep dish pizza pan. We fill the pie with the highest quality cheese and any combination of fresh toppings. Another thin layer of dough is then added to cover the filling. The pizza is then topped with our zesty, diced tomato sauce and is slowly cooked in our oven. The top layer of dough will melt into the cheese and seal in flavor as our flaky, buttery crust bakes until it is golden brown. Allow 30-40 minutes for Stuffed Pizzas. Zachary’s THIN Style pizza is a great choice for those who prefer a more traditional pizza. Our fresh, house made pizza dough is rolled to a moderate thickness and dusted with cornmeal. A specially seasoned, hearty diced tomato sauce is then applied along with the ingredients you choose. Allow 20-30 minutes for Thin Pizzas. Do you have an invoicing system for companies that order frequently? Yes! Please click here to learn more about creating an account with Zachary’s. Do you offer nutritional information of your pizza? NUTRITIONAL INFO FOR SMALL STUFFED PIZZA 8 servings per pizza CHEESE ONLY ONE MEAT SPINACH/MUSHROOM SERVING SIZE 131g 135g 131g CALORIES 283 303 270 TOTAL FAT 10g 12g 9g CHOLESTEROL 20mg 23mg 18mg CARBS 37g 37g 36g PROTEIN 13g 14g 12g These values are estimates only. Amounts vary from pizza to pizza and size of slice. Is gluten-free pizza crust available? Yes, in response to many requests from our customers, Zachary’s now offers a gluten-free thin crust pizza. Our gluten-free pizza is prepared and cooked on surfaces with exposure to wheat flour. Please be advised if you have a strong gluten intolerance. Do you ship your pizzas for mail order customers? To insure the best possible quality, we do not ship our pizzas. However, Zachary’s half-baked pizzas travel well! Customers regularly drive our half-bakes several hours and fly pizzas across the country. Are you hiring? Zachary’s Pizza is always looking for energetic, highly motivated, and hard-working people to join our wonderful crew at our Oakland- Rockridge, Oakland- Grand Lake, North Berkeley, Pleasant Hill, and Pleasanton locations. Click HERE for more information or to apply. Where does the Zachary’s Art on your walls come from? Since the mid-80’s, we have hosted an art contest open to all lovers of Zachary’s. Art is inspired by Zachary’s Chicago Pizza and the beautiful San Francisco Bay Area. We proudly display the art at our five locations in Oakland- Rockridge, Oakland- Grand Lake, North Berkeley, Pleasant Hill, and Pleasanton. You can view some of our classic and current winning submissions on our ART PAGE . Do you support any fundraising efforts? Yes! If you are interested in raising money for a local school or non-profit community organization, please contact us at fundraising@zacharys.com or fill out a form online here ! We can arrange a specific fundraising day for you at any Zachary’s location (Oakland- Rockridge, Oakland- Grand Lake, North Berkeley, Pleasant Hill, Pleasanton). Zachary’s will donate a percentage of revenue the day of your fundraiser to your school or organization. NY Pie | Where  Authentic New York Pizza Meets Nashville Soul
NY Pie | Where Authentic New York Pizza Meets Nashville Soul 0 Skip to Content About Menu Contact Us News Apply Here Gift Cards Order Now Open Menu Close Menu About Menu Contact Us News Apply Here Gift Cards Order Now Open Menu Close Menu About Menu Contact Us News Apply Here Gift Cards Order Now NY Pie... New York Pizza with Nashville Soul. At NY Pie, our vision is simple - to bring our customers the best NY style pizza outside of New York by using the freshest, highest quality ingredients prepared by thoroughly trained pizza makers. Since 2010, we’ve remained committed to delivering the same quality, flavor, and experience of a classic New York pizzeria, served with a warm welcome every time you visit. Learn more A Taste of New York, In The Heart Of Tennessee Hand-tossed, made fresh, and ready when you are. Order online and bring the taste of NY Pie home! Nashville West FRANKLIN HENDERSONVILLE CAPITOL VIEW Don’t Just Take It From Us I LOVE NY Pie! I also happen to be a pizza connoisseur who happens to very picky when it comes to finding the right place to grab a pie. It’s all about the ingredients! NY Pie’s crust is just the right amount of chewy and crispy — which tells me it’s fresh! The cheese gives you that good pull… You know the one. And the sauce is just the right amount of savory and sweet! The garlic knots are sinfully delicious, but I’m always cautious not to fill up before the main event! It would be a travesty for me not to be crowned your ULTIMATE PIZZA FAN because I rave to my family and friends that NY Pie’s pizza is the bees knees of Hendersonville! I’ll see you soon, so I can get my pizza fix AGAIN! - Cassie NYPIE in Franklin is hands down the best New York-style pizza you’ll find in Tennessee! The crust is that perfect balance of crispy on the outside, chewy on the inside, and the sauce has just the right amount of tangy sweetness. Every bite takes you straight to a classic NYC pizzeria. The staff is always friendly and welcoming, and the service is quick—even when they’re packed (which they often are because it's THAT good). Whether you're grabbing a quick slice or ordering a full pie, you won’t be disappointed. If you’re a pizza lover, this is a must-visit spot. Authentic, delicious, and consistently excellent—NYPIE is the real deal! - Steven I have been to NY Pie at least 20 times since they have opened. I have had everything from a quick lunch slice to an entire pie. Its honestly the best pizza in Tennessee. Also the garlic knots are the best I have ever had. I worked in Brooklyn for several years traveling from Franklin each week. My first stop was always to get a slice of real NY style pizza. I am so happy to have the real thing locally. Also the people running this place are amazing! So friendly and customer focused. You can't go wrong with NY Pie. It's so great to have them here in Franklin! Go see TJ and the team to experience the best around! - Brian Got a calzone and was super impressed. Ordered 5 toppings in it and it came out piping hot all the way through yet the crust was not over cooked as you would get most places with that many toppings. I was greeted when I went in and checked on well. This place is now a go-to for me. - Robb Would rate 10 stars if I could! Honestly the best pizza I’ve ever had. I got half NY cheese and half margherita and it was so delicious and full of flavor. Fast, friendly service and chill atmosphere with great music! Absolutely recommend! - Lizzy There is not a better slice of pie in this city. I live an hour away by car, the wrong way, but I'll walk there if you'll give me a bite - Garrett I Go In and one of the Employees already know me by my name as soon as they take a look at me lol. He’s cool and the pizza here is absolutely great. I’m From NYC and this hits damn near home for me. Thank you for bringing me back home every time I come here. Always worth the trip! - Luis I almost never write reviews but I HAVE to for NY Pie. I’ve been missing pizza from NJ/ NY since moving here for college and I couldn’t be happier I found this place! Super kind staff, tons of options in the front if you’re looking to grab a quick slice, and they get pies are in and out of the oven super quick. I’m so glad to have found a taste of home here and I can’t wait to bring my family! You guys are the best! - Jillian Five stars is inadequate....I would give NY Pie a 10! We are native New Yorkers and know what makes a good pie. We have been faithful customers for the past 8 years. Every Friday night we enjoy the best Pepperoni Pie and garlic knots that Nashville has to offer. Their pies rival any NY pie, perfectly cooked and delicious, everytime. The staff is so friendly and accommodating and very professional. We highly recommend them to everyone! - Betty We're vegetarians, so it’s great that there are some here to choose from. We always grab a medium vegetarian pizza to take home. There are other pizza places closer to our home, but NY Pie — which isn’t at all close to our neighborhood — is worth the time it takes to get there. - William If you ever want to feel like you are family; order your pizza from NY Pie. Every single time I enter the building I am greeted by name from every staff member. Go where everyone knows your name and is happy to see you. - Melinda I live next to a pizza place that I enjoy and rarely go to any other pizza restaurants, but when a friend showed me a pic of her salad from NY Pie, I had to have one. I hadn't heard about their salads before and was surprised that a pizza shop was making such tasty salads. Maybe one day I will try the pizza, but for now I'm in love with the salads Ms. T Yesterday, one of my co-workers (a New York native) told me about NY pie and how it’s the best pizza in this area he’s found & it’s real authentic New York pizza. I’m usually not big on pizza, but I had heard New York pizza is completely different, so when he told me that I knew I had to try. I ordered one right when I got off and oh my god this was literally the best pizza I have ever had. I will absolutely be coming back here! - Sky Holy cow!!! This pizza is amazing!!!!! Hands down delicious! The fella that took my order and the fella that cashed me out (possibly the same fella) very nice! Very professional! And did a great job getting my order correct! Thanks guys! I’ll definitely be back!! - Dave I LOVE this pizza and this Pizza Parlor! I Moved here LONG ago from the land of Pizza (New Jersey) and every time I see a sign that says real NY/NJ pizza I get so excited, only to be let down again. Lol. Not this one! You walk in and immediately are whisked back to childhood memories of the smell of wonderful pizza, a staff that’s on it, and a menu that mimics those small little places where great things and memories are made! It will ALWAYS be our go to! You won’t be sorry! When we go, I make a point of asking my son if he wants a pie for dinner (he works across the street) and you can hear it in his voice, it must run in our blood, but you know what you know. ❤️ They are the real deal! - Kathleen NY Pie - Music to Your Ears Check out this incredible song, written and recorded by Stephen Armes. It is a celebration of NY Pie - capturing the warmth, flavor, and spirit that keeps customers coming back! Whether you’re a first-time visitor or a regular, NY Pie is not a faceless chain. We are a locally-owned pizzeria where everyone feels like part of the family and where we take pride in our neighborhood and community.
